notes: 13 WebSearch calls (one returned a usage-limit error, so 12 returned results). Search summaries blend pages, so URLs are the pages named in results. Not retrieved at all, so removed or reworded: 'no routine test', symptoms before 45 GP advice, nurse, NICE POI blood-test and doubt-referral wording, hormonal-contraception reliability, mental health effect of early menopause. Added after retrieval (not first-pass claims): 12 months without a period, bleeding after sex advice (NHS inform), postmenopausal bleeding causes, palpitations/heavier bleeding GP advice, early advice reduces effects, NICE 2024 referral clarification, replace missing hormones before 45, fertility may be affected, WHC osteoporosis and MedlinePlus fezolinetant references. Claim ids follow first-pass ledger order (1-118); repeated sentences share evidence. NHS pages disagree on bioidentical hormones (one says available as HRT).
